about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Star Shikkha Poribar – Excellence in Education
about.body1: Education is the best means of self-improvement and of becoming an ideal human being. Keeping this in mind, Star Shikkha Poribar started its voyage with the motto "Shikkhai Alo" (Knowledge is Light). It is located in the well-ordered and safe environment of Natiapara, Delduar, Tangail.
about.body2: Founded on principles of academic excellence, discipline, and holistic development, the institution serves students from Class I through higher secondary level.

chairman.name: Md. Rashedul Islam
chairman.title: Chairman
chairman.defaultMessage: By competing with the country's leading educational institutions, we will, through Star Shikkha Poribar, develop the whole education system of Tangail district and build it into a model of modern education, Insha'Allah.
